title: pandanus tectorius var. drolletianus
intro: Pandanus tectorius var. drolletianus, commonly known as the Tahitian breadfruit or Tahitian pandan, is a variety of the pandan plant that belongs to the Pandanaceae family. It is a tropical plant with edible fruit and leaves, traditionally used in Polynesian cuisine. The leaves of the plant have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
